title: CodeChef: Chef and Rainbow Array
description: An array is a Rainbow Array if: 1. Contains only elements 1 through 7. 2. Starts with 1s, then 2s ... up to 7s, then descends back down to 1s. 3. Symmetrical (palindrome). Return 'yes' if rainbow, else 'no'.
explanation: Validates palindrome symmetry, presence of exactly 1..7, and incremental ordering up to apex 7 in O(N) time.
